$comment: The structured facts of one feature's design (.jairus/features/<feature>/spec.json), written by the designer and checked by bin/check-feature.mjs (rules/design-workflow.md). It holds only what the starter cannot: acceptance criteria and their traceability, the Extension plan, extension requests and each entry point's guard and audit. Naming rules, table classes and RLS are the starter's (definePlugin, db:setup, verify-rls, pnpm gate:core enforce them when the code exists). Narrative lives in PRD.md, DESIGN.md and ADR.md; do not restate these facts there. `point` is a contribution kind of @jairus/plugin-kit (permissions, nav, tables, migrations, emails, jobs, on, env, audit, orgActions, roles, repos, features) or code (the plugin's domain and use-case code), branding, route (route files in the apps), cli. A config card (plugin: null) may only use branding. A need no point can meet goes in extension_plan.requests, never worked around. After develop the developer fills implemented_at (<file>:<line> of the export, with `// AC-n` on or above it) and test_at (a test file that names the criterion).
